title: Config loader accepts unknown keys
body:
**Finding:** Unknown keys are ignored, so a typo silently keeps the default.

**Recommendation:** Fix it.

title: No upper bound on retry backoff
body:
**Finding:** Backoff doubles without a cap, so a long outage delays recovery by hours.

**Recommendation:** Fix it.

title: Retry counts cancelled requests
body:
**Finding:** A cancelled request consumes an attempt, so a user cancel can exhaust retries.

**Recommendation:** Fix it.

title: Cache key ignores the API version
body:
**Finding:** Two API versions share one cache entry, so a client can read a stale shape.

**Recommendation:** Fix it.

title: Error message leaks the request URL
body:
**Finding:** The URL can carry a token in its query string.

**Recommendation:** Fix it.

title: Trailing bytes accepted after the payload
body:
**Finding:** The parser stops at the first object and ignores the rest.

**Recommendation:** Fix it.

title: Metrics label has unbounded cardinality
body:
**Finding:** The label carries the full path, so each widget id creates a series.

**Recommendation:** Fix it.
